headline: Sensex surges over 700 points and Nifty crosses 25,200 as foreign investors return and Moody's upgrades growth forecast

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Indian stock markets surged strongly with Sensex rising over 700 points and Nifty topping 25,200.
Foreign investors returned to Indian stocks, helping indices reach an eight-month high.
Moody's raised India's FY27 growth estimate to 7% citing broad-based momentum.
PSU banking stocks surged significantly, while IT and Pharma sectors experienced pullbacks.
whatHappening: Bajaj Finance is planning to launch a share sale worth up to Rs 11,700 crore this week.
Q2 earnings results saw Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar widen its losses while Orient Green Power expanded margins.
The Indian government barred the export of lithium-ion battery waste and scrap containing black mass.
Silver ETF inflows recorded a strong month-on-month growth of 56%.
summary:
Indian benchmark indices posted strong gains on November 11, 2026, with Sensex jumping over 700 points and Nifty crossing 25,200.
The market rally was supported by returning foreign institutional investors and Moody's upgrading India's FY27 GDP growth forecast to 7%.
PSU banks led market gains while Q2 corporate earnings and a potential Rs 11,700 crore share sale by Bajaj Finance remained in focus.
